content_blocks.label: clause_1._Personal_Property
content_blocks.text: I direct that my personal property, including but not limited to jewelry and collectibles, be distributed equally among my children.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Real_Property
content_blocks.text: My residence located at 123 Main Street, Clearwater City, Clearwater County, State of Novaria, shall be inherited by my spouse, Emily Johnson.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Funeral_Arrangements
content_blocks.text: My funeral arrangements shall be handled by Johnson Funeral Home, and my remains shall be interred in the family plot at Green Lawn Cemetery.
